prompts.radial: Use case: ui-mockup. Production raster sprite for a mobile game HUD. Minimal, immediately legible, flat UI matching a warm dark-brown and muted amber western game menu. Absolutely no wood grain, metal, rivets, screws, bevels, gradients, texture, lighting, glows, embossing, shadows, decorative caps or doubled outlines. Smooth clean geometry. Only two opaque colors: dark brown #241A12 and thin muted amber #C98A38. True transparent background outside the object. No text, icons, labels, watermark or extra elements. One large circular SIX-section annular menu, exactly six equal 60-degree wedges. Top wedge points straight up, edges at -120 and -60 degrees; other wedges evenly clockwise. Center at exact image center. Outer radius 45% of canvas width, inner circular transparent hole radius 17% of canvas width. Flat solid brown wedge interiors. One fine amber outer circumference and inner circumference, and six thin amber radial separator lines. Amber lines uniformly about 0.5% canvas width. Do not include a center button. No gaps between sectors except the fine amber seams. Square canvas.

prompts.icons: Use case: ui-mockup. Production GUI icon sprite atlas for a mobile game. Minimal flat monochrome pictograms, strong simple silhouettes readable at 24 pixels, warm ivory #F6D5A0 filled shapes only on genuinely transparent background. NO outlines, shading, gradients, textures, glows, shadows, thin decorative details, letters, numbers, grid lines, backplates or colored backgrounds. Use broad clean shapes and a few large transparent cutouts only. EXACT 4 columns and 4 rows of equally spaced square cells on a square image, all 16 cells occupied. Each icon centered in its cell and occupies central 60%, separated by generous transparent margins. Exact row-major icons: Row 1: simple mouse head with two large round ears and short pointed snout (poses menu), open door with right arrow, simple steam locomotive silhouette with right arrow, backpack silhouette with one pocket cutout. Row 2: simple folded map with two fold lines, three horizontal dots, upright standing MOUSE with unmistakable round ears and curved tail, MOUSE sitting on a simple chair with unmistakable round ears and tail. Row 3: MOUSE lying stretched out with round ears and tail, animal pawprint, crossed wrench and hammer, open book. Row 4: simple eight-tooth gear with circular cutout, plain X, two pause bars, six dots in a circle. Critters-only world: the standing, sitting and lying icons must ALL clearly be mice, NEVER human/stick-person figures or human hands. Mice have no clothing or facial detail except at most one large eye cutout. All other pictograms equally minimal, bold and consistent. No realism, no detailed cartoon characters, no hat, costume or tiny features.
prompts.center: Use case: ui-mockup. One production raster GUI sprite, a plain circular cancel button. Centered exact circle with radius 45 percent of a square canvas, entirely filled with flat dark brown #241A12, outlined by ONE thin muted amber #C98A38 line of thickness 0.5 percent canvas width. Everything outside the circle genuinely transparent. Interior blank: no icon, letter, X, label or divider. Minimal functional UI, no material texture, wood, metal, screws, rivets, gradients, shadows, bevels, glows or decorative details. Simple flat appearance matching a dark brown mobile radial menu.
